question: As per a brand valuation report released by Brand Finance in February 2022, what is the rank of Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) in the list of insurance brands globally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10th**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per a brand valuation report released by **Brand Finance in February 2022, **the Li**fe Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)** is ranked at the **10th** position among insurance brands globally.
 
• Brand Finance is a leading brand valuation consultancy that assesses the value and strength of brands worldwide.
 
• **LIC is the only Indian insurance company to feature in the top 10 of this global list.**
 
• The ranking reflects LIC's strong market presence, brand value, and customer trust.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)** was established in** 1956 and is the largest insurance company in India.**
 
• LIC offers a wide range of life insurance products to cater to various customer needs, including life insurance, health insurance, pension plans, and unit-linked plans.
 
• LIC has a vast network of agents and offices across India, making insurance accessible to a large population.
 
• Brand Finance's report highlights the importance of brand strength and value in the competitive insurance industry.
 
• LIC's inclusion in the top 10 global insurance brands showcases its significant role in the global insurance market.
